summary:
I built the workbook with 42 test cases: 25 functional and 17 API. By category that's 5 Positive, 18 Negative, 12 Corner and 7 Boundary; by criticality, 17 High, 17 Medium and 8 Low. All 3 requirements are covered (100%) and the build listed none as uncovered. There are no role or permission tests because the requirements only mention anonymous visitors.
Files are in `output/2026-11-19-d723a7/`: `news-letter-v3_TestCases.xlsx`, `news-letter-v3_testcases.json`, and two TestRail CSVs (`news-letter-v3_TestCases_testrail_functional.csv` and `news-letter-v3_TestCases_testrail_api.csv`). To import, use Test Cases → Import → CSV with the "Test Case (Text)" template.
Top open questions: the exact success message and the body of the 201 response; whether duplicate checks ignore case and trim spaces; which email format rules apply, including unicode addresses; and whether the endpoint needs auth, CAPTCHA, rate limiting or a confirmation email.
Until those are answered, the cases assume a public endpoint, trimmed emails compared without regard to case, and a 100-character limit checked after trimming. All of these are listed on the Assumptions & Questions tab.
